races.paceDynamic: Embarked will set the pace from the front with little competition, creating a sustainable tempo that won't collapse. Rainbow Sign and Barnsnape Boy may sit prominent but neither has the natural speed to pressure the leader early. The lack of genuine pace pressure means this becomes a tactical affair where positioning and finishing kick matter more than raw speed. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late runs, as the moderate gallop will bunch the field and create a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Embarked sets an uncontested lead and the pace stays moderate
scenarios.body: The field bunches up behind the steady gallop and it becomes a sprint finish where the freshest finishers prevail. Hold-up horses with tactical speed get the perfect setup to unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Embarked gets away with very soft fractions and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the field struggles to close on good ground. Prominent racers get involved but can't peg back the escapee.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Rainbow Sign or Barnsnape Boy can track Embarked into contention
scenarios.body: The race becomes a battle between the early positions with pace-tracking horses getting first run. Late runners find themselves too far back to make meaningful inroads.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes crawling and no horse can find acceleration
scenarios.body: The race turns into a messy affair where form completely goes out the window. Any horse that shows a semblance of pace late can steal it.

Pacific Prince and Mokata both carry fade warnings which makes them risky in what should become a finishing kick contest
The moderate pace could turn this into a lottery where any horse showing late pace can be competitive regardless of ability

races.paceDynamic: Mister Sandman and Washington Heir will likely contest the early lead, with Poetic Jack tracking close behind in a prominent position. The presence of multiple front-runners should create a genuine pace, particularly over this sharp 5½f trip at Brighton where there's limited time to recover from tactical errors. With six of eight runners preferring hold-up tactics, the majority will be relying on late pickups behind what should be a solid gallop. This pace setup strongly favours prominent racers and early pace-setters who can avoid getting swamped by the large contingent of hold-up horses in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained pace suits leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Mister Sandman and Washington Heir establish a strong but sustainable gallop
scenarios.body: The front pair stretch the field and prove hard to peg back, with the hold-up brigade left with too much to do. Prominent runners like Poetic Jack benefit from the perfect position to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: False pace favours closers
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes steady with the leaders going too slow
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses gets the perfect setup for their preferred style with a sprint finish. Big Time Rascal and Lynwood Lad can unleash their finishing kicks from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hot pace collapses leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Mister Sandman and Washington Heir duel early and weaken
scenarios.body: The front-runners burn each other out in a speed battle, setting up the race perfectly for mid-division runners. Horses with tactical speed like Poetic Jack can capitalise on the carnage ahead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos benefits outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a messy tactical affair with no clear pace
scenarios.body: The lack of early tempo creates a muddled contest where form goes out the window and outsiders can sneak through. Previous course winner Lynwood Lad knows how to win this specific race.

races.paceDynamic: King Of War will take this race on from the front with minimal early opposition, creating a sustainable tempo over the mile trip. Lordsbridge Grey, Tactical Plan and Amused may sit prominent but are unlikely to force the pace hard early. The lack of natural speed horses means King Of War can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march turning for home. This moderate tempo strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending energy, while hold-up horses face the classic Brighton problem of needing things to fall right from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: King Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If King Of War gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The front-runner exploits the tactical advantage while prominent horses can't bridge the gap up Brighton's stiff finish. Hold-up horses are left with too much to do from poor positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If Lordsbridge Grey or Tactical Plan press King Of War from early stages
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up a more genuine pace where the best horses can come from midfield positions. King Of War may tire from fighting for the lead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly unsustainable through rival front-running tactics
scenarios.body: Late closers get the perfect setup to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. The stamina test favours horses proven over the trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If King Of War goes too slow early then multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: A messy sprint finish develops where the best turn of foot wins regardless of position. Form horses with tactical speed hold the edge.

races.paceDynamic: Night Bear will take this field along at a steady gallop from the front, with Letsbeatsepsis and Masqool tracking in prominent positions through the early stages. The sustainable pace will allow the large field of hold-up horses including Fighting Poet, Little Tiger, and Bohemian Breeze to settle comfortably in behind. With only one confirmed leader and no obvious pace pressure, this sets up perfectly for closers to wind up from the back over the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as the modest early gallop will leave plenty in reserve for the business end.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If Night Bear sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays steady throughout
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop will suit patient riders who can produce their horses with one run from off the pace. Hold-up horses like Fighting Poet and Little Tiger will have every chance to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If Letsbeatsepsis and Masqool can secure ideal tracking positions behind Night Bear
scenarios.body: These horses will get first run on the leaders while the back markers are still organising their challenges. Their prominent position gives them tactical advantage when the pace lifts approaching the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Night Bear gets away with very soft sectionals and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: The veteran can utilise his early advantage if the pace stays pedestrian enough to preserve his stamina. His Brighton course form gives him confidence to dictate terms from pillar to post.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling and produces a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the two-furlong pole favouring horses with instant acceleration. This tactical lottery can throw up surprise results from anywhere in the field.

races.paceDynamic: Rivera Queen looks the only confirmed front runner in this small field, with A Lott Of Kane, Arvana Belle, Saeculamation and Poetic Grace all showing prominent tendencies but likely to settle just behind. Cape Toronada, Lieutenant Sir and No Claims Bonus prefer to come from off the pace. With just Rivera Queen wanting the early lead, she should get an uncontested run to the turn, creating a sustainable tempo that won't stretch the field. This honest pace setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can benefit from the solid gallop and finish fastest when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Rivera Queen sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays honest throughout
scenarios.body: The patient riders get perfect splits in the straight as the early pace fades, with Cape Toronada and No Claims Bonus sweeping past tired leaders. Lieutenant Sir could also benefit if sharp enough after his long absence.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent group takes over
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses successfully track Rivera Queen and kick clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: A Lott Of Kane and Arvana Belle use their tactical speed to bridge from the pace, while Saeculamation and Poetic Grace pick up the pieces from their forward positions. The hold-up horses are left with too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Rivera Queen wires field
scenarios.trigger: If Rivera Queen's sustainable pace allows her to maintain her kick to the line without the usual fade
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader gets first run and holds on grimly, with the prominent horses unable to match her tactical advantage. Her recent third at Redcar suggests the ability is there if she can find her stamina.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Rivera Queen goes too slowly early and creates a sprint finish from the final two furlongs
scenarios.body: The race becomes a dash where pure speed matters most, suiting horses with natural acceleration regardless of running style. Saeculamation's versatility and Poetic Grace's recent form become key factors.

races.paceDynamic: Recon Mission will take this field along from the front at a sustainable pace, with Merrimack, Mick's Spirit, Secret Handsheikh and Kento all capable of tracking close behind. The pace shouldn't be fierce early with only one confirmed front runner, but the sprint finish over 5½f at Brighton favours those able to position handy. With multiple prominent runners and hold-up horses like Rory Rocket and Ancient State needing to make ground late, this shape clearly favours front runners and prominent racers who can secure good early positions without pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Recon Mission controls the tempo without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The veteran can dictate fractions and kick clear in the straight while prominent runners like Merrimack and Kento are best placed to respond. Hold-up horses face too much to do from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners (Merrimack, Mick's Spirit, Kento) press Recon Mission early
scenarios.body: The pace quickens sufficiently to set up the race for a strong closer like Rory Rocket or Ancient State who can unleash late runs. Front runners tire in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sprint Dash Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is very steady with bunched field turning in
scenarios.body: It becomes a pure sprint finish where class and speed tell, favouring the highest-rated runners regardless of position. Merrimack's course form and Ancient State's 5f record become decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Recon Mission goes too fast early under pressure from multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The leaders come back dramatically in the final furlong, allowing a patient ride on Roman Spring or Secret Handsheikh to pick up the pieces. The race falls apart for the early leaders.
